name: Camp Poco (Pocantico Hills Summer Day Camp)
description_short: Six week school district day camp in its 70th year at Pocantico Hills in Sleepy Hollow, open to district residents and to families from outside the district. Camp runs 9 to 3 with early drop off and late pick up, and ends the summer with a color war tradition.
notes: Camp hours 9 am to 3 pm; early drop off from 8 am and late pick up 3 to 5 pm (no late pick up on the last day). Residents zoned to Pocantico Hills School registered first (from February 2), then returning families, then open registration for residents and non-residents from February 23. Tuition is in a 2026 Tuition Rates document that could not be read (403). The address is the district's, at 599 Bedford Road.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Day Camp page: June 29 to August 7, 2026, closed July 3, 9 to 3 with early and late options, registration for residents and non-residents; district address in the footer.

source.title: Pocantico Hills CSD - Summer Day Camp

for_andrew: No price or ages: the 2026 Tuition Rates and flyer documents on the district's SharePoint returned 403, so I took that as final. The street address is the district office in the page footer; the page doesn't say the camp is held there. List without price, or ask the camp for the rates?
